note: Generated by design/tools/boss_kaleidos.py. World units, boss space. Arms at k x 60 degrees, k = 0..5; pair = k mod 3 (A, B, C); the two arms of a pair share one health pool and shatter together. Facet segments are arm-local (x outward along the arm) as [x0,y0,x1,y1,layer]. Colours: pair A, B, C take the run's enemy hues 1, 2, 3 with their partners, drawn as elites (white copy, glass, flares); the resting pair is drawn white-hot.

lens.note: two plates per pair, centred on its arms; they stop shots; they shatter with the pair

iris.note: open for the whole of beat 1 of every bar

healthRing.note: an arc that shortens clockwise from the top as the core loses health

phases.name: Bloom
phases.schedule: each bar one pair rests in turn (A, B, C); the other two fire

phases.name: Refraction
phases.schedule: the two pairs alternate bars; the pair that rested opens its bar with a beam

beam.note: along the arm, out to the arena wall; it sweeps as the wheel turns

phases.name: Spiral
phases.schedule: fires for three beats, rests on beat 4 of every bar

phases.name: Naked core
phases.schedule: the core fires on every beat; from the ninth bar on every eighth

coreBurst.on: every beat, alternate bursts turned half a step

music.layer: glass bells (the P3 bell patch), one voice per pair: A plays the chord root, B the third, C the fifth
music.rule: a pair's bell sounds on every step it fires, so the fans are heard as an ostinato and the resting pair is a hole in it
music.onPairDeath: that voice leaves the chord for good; a low growl (the elite-arrives patch) enters one octave down
music.coreDownbeat: a deep gong on beat 1 while the iris is open

accent.use: core rings, lens plates, arm tips and spines: a boss is the one enemy with a second colour family, the complement of its Track's palette

reflections.note: arm hulls only, behind the wheel, never on the priority layer
arm hulls only, behind the wheel, never on the priority layer

numbers.entrance: on the Drop's downbeat six facets streak in along the mirror axes and lock together over one bar, inner to outer; the name card KALEIDOS holds for two bars
numbers.death: iris wide open, clamped white flash, every facet tumbles outward in six-fold symmetry, three rings, 300+ sparks, 30 px distortion ring, 50 ms hit-stop, then 200 Shards
